remarks:
Experience exceptional lakefront living in the heart of the Village of Lakewood. This one-of-a-kind Chautauqua Lake home offers over 3,000 square feet of thoughtfully designed living space with breathtaking water views, distinctive architectural details, and luxury finishes throughout. The spacious layout features four bedrooms and five bathrooms, including an impressive primary suite complete with a fireplace, spa-inspired bath, Roman shower, garden tub, and walk-in dressing room.

The main level offers an inviting living room with a fireplace and expansive sliding glass doors leading to a covered lakeside porch and stamped concrete patio, creating the perfect setting for entertaining or relaxing while enjoying spectacular sunsets. The well-appointed kitchen includes generous cabinetry, abundant counter space, a wet bar, and multiple dining areas. Additional highlights include a family room with a gas stove, hardwood and tile flooring, custom Pella windows and doors, central air, an oversized attached two-car garage, and a unique crow's nest retreat overlooking the lake.

Outside, enjoy private lake frontage with a dock, boat lift, and exceptional outdoor living space. Located just minutes from Lakewood's restaurants, shops, parks, and amenities, this extraordinary waterfront property offers a rare opportunity to own one of Chautauqua Lake's truly distinctive homes.
